 [This story contains spoilers for episode nine of Dancing With the Stars season 35.] 
 It’s time for Disney Night on Dancing With the Stars . 
 This year’s Disney -themed episode sports a new Broadway twist, with “performances inspired by beloved Disney stories and their iconic stage adaptations,” per ABC . Couples are paying homage to classics from Mary Poppins , The Little Mermaid , Tangled , Beauty and the Beast and many more. 
 Tuesday night’s episode also saw the return of the team dances, as co-hosts Alfonso Ribeiro and Julianne Hough each joined one of the group performances. Cynthia Erivo was also in the ballroom, joining as the night’s guest judge.

 Celebrities still competing on season 35 include Tatyana Ali , Jenna Dewan , Ezra Frech , Amber Glenn , Maura Higgins, Harry Shum Jr., Julia Stiles and Connor Wood.
 After the first dance of Disney Night, Hough announced that the couple who tops the leaderboard after the individual performances will receive immunity from next week’s dance-off. The couple who early on took that lead was Harry and Jenna Johnson, who earned a perfect 40/40 for their jazz to “Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious” from Marry Poppins .
 Harry and Jenna earned the first perfect score of DWTS season 35 last week, with Disney Night marking their second 40/40 in a row. 
 During last week’s Horror Movie Night , Jackson Olson and Tyler Cameron were kicked off the competition in a double elimination. 
 The couple with the lowest combined total of judges’ scores and viewer votes is eliminated at the end of each DWTS episode. Each viewer is allowed up to 10 votes per couple, per voting method (via ABC’s website and by text).
 Live voting takes place during the East Coast airing of each show and ends shortly after the final performance; that means if you’re a West Coast viewer and want to vote , you must do so between 5 p.m. PT and roughly 6:45 p.m. PT, as voting ends after the final performance.
 See the full list of scores for Disney Night (including the solo and team dances) below.
 Disney Night Solo Dance Scores 
 Amber Glenn and Pasha Pashkov: 34/40
Maura Higgins and Mark Ballas : 32/40
Tatyana Ali and Jan Ravnik : 33/40
Harry Shum Jr. and Jenna Johnson : 40/40
Ezra Frech and Daniella Karagach: 37/40
Julia Stiles and Ezra Sosa: 33/40
Jenna Dewan and Val Chmerkovskiy: 40/40
Connor Wood and Rylee Arnold 
 Disney Night Group Dance Scores 
 Team Slaytopia 
Alfonso Ribeiro; Tatyana (Team Captain) and Jan; Maura and Mark; Amber and Pasha; and Julia and Ezra
 Team Wildcats 
With Julianne Hough; Connor (Team Captain) and Rylee; Ezra and Dani; Jenna and Val; and Harry and Jenna
 Season 35 of Dancing With the Stars airs Tuesdays at 8 p.m., simulcasting across ABC and Disney+ and streaming the next day on Hulu . Check out all of The Hollywood Reporter ’s DWTS coverage here .
